claims.claim: ⚠️ **A pure benzodiazepine overdose typically gives mild–moderate CNS depression. Deep coma needing ventilation is uncommon — if you see it, look for other toxins.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Management rests on close observation plus supportive care.** **Every intentional overdose needs a mental health assessment.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Sedation can last up to 36 hours.** Peak levels come 30–90 minutes after ingestion.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Midazolam has a short half-life but active metabolites that accumulate with repeated doses**, prolonging sedation. **Diazepam is long-acting** (half-life over 24 hours) and clears poorly in children with liver disease.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Assess:** any child with CNS impairment, and every significant accidental ingestion or deliberate self-poisoning — **toddlers and younger children especially**. ⚠️ **Consider non-accidental poisoning** if the developmental age doesn't fit.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Always assume the maximum number of missing tablets was taken**, and work out, for each drug, the highest possible dose per kg.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Look for:** confusion, dysarthria, nystagmus, ataxia, hypotonia, seizure · respiratory depression · hypotension · hypothermia · withdrawal or paradoxical reactions (agitation, aggression, hallucinations).
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Accidental overdose: usually no tests.** **Intentional overdose: 12-lead ECG, paracetamol level and BSL** for co-ingestants. **Benzodiazepine levels don't help.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **With respiratory depression, suspect an opioid co-ingestant** — giving parenteral naloxone is reasonable.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Activated charcoal is contraindicated** (aspiration risk). **Enhanced elimination doesn't work** and isn't recommended.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **In intentional overdose flumazenil is contraindicated** — seizures may be precipitated in mixed overdoses or withdrawal. It **is an option after accidental or iatrogenic overdose**, and may be considered for severe CNS depression. **Always discuss with a toxicologist** (13 11 26).
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Flumazenil: 0.01 mg/kg IV over 15 seconds, max 0.2 mg** (initial dose).
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Most isolated ingestions can go home if asymptomatic at 4 hours.** **Admit if still intoxicated beyond 4 hours**; consider admission for every intentional overdose.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Transfer children with CNS depression needing airway protection** — PIPER 1300 137 650.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Discharge: normal GCS after 4 hours' observation and able to walk.** Adolescents with deliberate ingestion need a self-harm risk assessment and a drug and alcohol assessment first.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Benzodiazepine poisoning' (Last Updated April 2019), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Benzodiazepine_poisoning/, retrieved 2026-09-23
